title: A RNA-Seq Analysis of the Response of Photosynthetic System to Low Nitrogen Supply in Maize Leaf
tissue: leaf (mature tissue of an expanding leaf; leaf number not stated)
stage_age: LN imposed at leaf-3 full expansion; harvest at leaf-6 full expansion
growth_system: hydroponic (aerated, renewed every 2 d); growth chamber 28/22 °C, 14/10 h, 250-300 µmol m-2 s-1
N_treatments: HN 4.0 mM NO3- (Ca(NO3)2) vs LN 40 µM NO3- (CaCl2 added to balance Ca)
timepoints_duration: LN from leaf-3 full expansion to leaf-6 full expansion (duration in days NR); single sampling
repository: NCBI GEO (paper text says Sequence Read Archive)
other_omics: physiology (gas exchange; chlorophyll fluorescence; chlorophyll and N content)
key_finding: Low N downregulated PSI/PSII and light-harvesting genes, matching reduced chlorophyll fluorescence and photosynthesis.
source_of_details: PMC full text; publisher page (MDPI) for accession
notes: Accession was stripped from the PMC text and taken from the publisher page; paper names SRA but cites a GEO series ID; only 2 reps; >33 M PE125 reads per treatment

title: Integrated GWAS and Transcriptome Analysis Reveal the Genetic and Molecular Basis of Low Nitrogen Tolerance in Maize Seedlings
genotypes: low-N-tolerant (LNT) group: GEMS59; Lx9801; Dan4245; GEMS2; N-sensitive (NS) group: Dong46; CIMBL16; CML304; CML115 (extremes selected from a 201-inbred panel)
stage_age: N treatment from two-leaf-one-heart stage; sampled at four-leaf stage (about 20 d)
growth_system: growth incubator/chamber 24/22 °C, 14/10 h; plastic pots irrigated with 30 mL nutrient solution every 48 h; substrate NR
N_treatments: LN 0.05 mmol/L vs normal N 4 mmol/L (N form NR)
timepoints_duration: about 20 d of treatment; single sampling at four-leaf stage
n_libraries: 24 (stated: 2 groups x 2 N levels x 2 tissues x 3 reps)
other_omics: GWAS (55K SNP array; 201 inbreds); seedling phenotyping; qRT-PCR
key_finding: Tolerant lines had 3.4-fold fewer low-N DEGs than sensitive lines; GWAS/RNA-seq integration yielded eight candidate genes.
source_of_details: PMC full text (Data Availability Statement absent from PMC text; publisher page fetch truncated before it)
notes: How the 4 lines per group were combined into 24 libraries is not described (pooling implied, not stated); N form and pot substrate NR; Data Availability Statement could not be read, so an accession may exist

title: Transcription factor ZmEREB97 regulates nitrate uptake in maize (Zea mays) roots
genotypes: B73; Mo17 (B73 recovers faster from N deficiency, termed more nitrate-sensitive); separate set: zmereb97 Mu-insertion mutant (B73 background) and CRISPR-Cas9 knockout (KN5585 background) with WT siblings
n_genotypes: 2 (nitrate series); mutant set: 2 mutant alleles + WT siblings
growth_system: hydroponic (modified half-strength Hoagland); growth environment NR
N_treatments: 15 mM KNO3 vs 15 mM KCl control (nitrate induction); mutant RNA-seq at 5 mM KNO3 only
other_factors: genotype (B73 vs Mo17); separate WT vs zmereb97 comparison at a single N level
timepoints_duration: 0.5 h and 8 h after supply named in text (full time-point list and pre-treatment NR)
n_libraries: 36 (B73/Mo17 nitrate series, stated); mutant set NR
platform_layout: Illumina (model and read layout NR; Berry Genomics)
other_omics: DAP-seq (Illumina HiSeq 2500 SE100); Y1H; EMSA; NMT and 15N-nitrate influx; qPCR
key_finding: Nitrate-induced AP2/ERF factor ZmEREB97 binds GCC-box motifs and activates six ZmNRT genes, promoting nitrate uptake.
notes: 'Accession numbers' section lists gene IDs only, no RNA-seq or DAP-seq accession; methods give little design detail; mutant RNA-seq (WT vs zmereb97 roots, 5 mM KNO3) is not N-varied; 6,069 B73 DEGs intersected with DAP-seq peaks

title: Genome-Wide Identification and Functional Analysis of Nitrate Transporter Genes (NPF, NRT2 and NRT3) in Maize
genotypes: Xu178 (RNA-seq); Xu178; Zong3; Mo17; B73 by qRT-PCR only (differing nitrate uptake rates)
stage_age: seedlings; N deprivation started when leaf 3 emerged from the collar (about 7 d in HN)
growth_system: hydroponic (germinated in sand); growth environment NR
N_treatments: HN 4 mM NO3- (Ca(NO3)2) -> N deprivation 0 N (CaCl2 to balance Ca) for 96 h -> resupply 4 mM NO3- for 24 h
timepoints_duration: deprivation 0, 3, 12, 24, 96 h; resupply 3, 12, 24 h (8 time points)
n_libraries: 48 (stated: 8 time points x 2 tissues x 3 reps)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq X Ten, PE150 (TruSeq RNA v2)
other_omics: qRT-PCR (4 inbreds); nitrate uptake kinetics; public qTeller expression data
key_finding: NRT genes showed tissue-specific responses to N starvation and resupply; six key NRTs differed among inbreds.
notes: Only Xu178 was sequenced; the 4-inbred comparison is qRT-PCR only; deprivation 0 h serves as HN baseline

title: Nitrogen supply affects ion homeostasis by modifying root Casparian strip formation through the miR528-LAC3 module in maize
genotypes: B73 (implied by context; transgenic CZ01-background lines not sequenced)
stage_age: seedlings; 3 d after N treatment onset (8 d germination in paper rolls + 4 d in Hoagland before treatment)
growth_system: hydroponic (3-L pots, Hoagland); growth chamber 28/22 °C, 14/10 h
N_treatments: N luxury 8 mM NO3- vs N deficient 0.04 mM NO3- (N sufficient 4 mM used elsewhere, not sequenced)
platform_layout: NR (libraries 'as described previously'; >220 M raw reads in total)
other_omics: ionomics (ICP-MS); Casparian strip histochemistry; stem-loop qRT-PCR and small RNA gel blot for miR528; field ionomics of ZmLAC3-OE
key_finding: N deficiency accelerates root Casparian strip formation; ZmmiR528-ZmLAC3 module links N supply to ion homeostasis.
notes: No data availability statement in PMC text (back matter present); RNA-seq genotype not restated but the N experiments used B73; reads mapped to B73 RefGen_v4

title: The pho1;2a'-m1.1 allele of Phosphate1 conditions misregulation of the phosphorus starvation response in maize (Zea mays ssp. mays L.)
genotypes: W22-background segregants for pho1;2a'-m1.1 (transposon footprint allele): wild type; heterozygous; homozygous mutant (3 sibling families)
growth_system: greenhouse; PVC tubes (15 cm x 50 cm) of washed sand with solid-phase P buffer; 1/3-strength modified Hoagland
N_treatments: Full 1750 µM NO3- vs LowN 157.5 µM NO3- (KNO3/Ca(NO3)2 replaced by KCl/CaCl2), crossed with 333 vs 10 µM PO4 (Full; LowN; LowP; LowNP)
other_factors: P level (low P); pho1;2a mutant genotype
timepoints_duration: treatments applied from 10 DAE (200 mL every third day); harvest 25 DAE
n_libraries: 48 (computed: 3 genotypes x 4 treatments x 2 tissues x 2 reps)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 4000 (leaf) and NextSeq 550 (root); read layout NR
other_omics: ionomics (ICP-MS); growth and root architecture phenotyping; qRT-PCR
key_finding: pho1;2a mutation mainly upregulated genes; leaf misregulation specific to low P and combined low N+P.
notes: Wild-type segregant libraries were also analysed in Torres-Rodriguez et al. (cited in paper; same N x P design); leaf and root libraries sequenced on different platforms and sites

title: Integrative meta-QTL and RNA-Seq analysis reveals valine-glutamine (VQ) motif-containing ZmVQ56 as a key regulator of water-nitrogen interaction in maize (Zea mays L.)
N_treatments: normal N vs low N (rates, units and N form NR)
other_omics: meta-QTL; Arabidopsis ZmVQ56 overexpression and atsib1 mutant phenotyping
key_finding: Meta-QTL plus water-N RNA-seq nominated ZmVQ56; Arabidopsis overexpression reduced root growth and shoot nitrate under low N and drought.
source_of_details: abstract only (no PMC full text; web search found no accession)
notes: 3,430 root and 7,703 leaf DEGs (abstract); full text not read, so N rates, growth system, stage and replication unknown; check the publisher page for a data statement
